changelog: Remote/TV navigation overhaul: Home opens focused on Watch Now, every page remembers where you left it, and sidebar crossings are clearer — the page dims and resizes beside the open drawer
Fixed: switching episodes could throw focus down to the episode list and scroll the page — focus stays on the player now
Fixed: returning to the top of Home could show only the bottom of the carousel — it stays framed now
Loading placeholders and the About changelog are reachable with the remote
Sync is lighter: uploads send only the entries that changed instead of your whole history and favorites
